notifications.name: Crackle King
notifications.riskType: Burns, Damage to hearing, Fire, Injuries
notifications.danger: The article has too many duds with and without fuse, users ignite them causing injuries and/or burns. In addition, the fuse delay is excessively long, which may lead users to approach the firework too early while it is still active, increasing the risk of being struck by pyrotechnic effects. Additionally, the sound pressure level is too high. Consequently, it can cause damage to hearing. The firework may also burst or eject burning material outside the designated safety distance of 8 m or below a height of 3 m, potentially hitting and injuring users. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Pyrotechnics Directive nor with the European standard EN 15947.

notifications.name: Golden Temple
notifications.danger: The article has too many duds with and without fuse, users can ignite them causing injuries and/or burns. Further, the fireworks may burst or release burning material outside the safety distance of 8 m or below a height of 3 m, which may result in the user being hit by the pyrotechnical effects and matter from the product. This can lead to injuries, burns and fire. Moreover, the article has a too long fuse delay. This may cause the user to walk to the article too early with the danger that fireworks could hit the user, causing injuries and/or burns. In addition, the article does not extinguish after functioning within 120 seconds, which may cause fire to surrounding objects. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Pyrotechnics Directive nor with the European standard EN 15947.
